title: Fix some item warnings
description:
Mostly mask widths, but uncovered several issues.

For DRSUAPI, NDR.pm was generating a test for when seen bits don't match those defined in a bitmap set.
It would still get confused about seeing the same bits set in > 1 field within the set
(which check_typed_item_calls.py spotted). Now that it sees the bitmap mask as 0xffffffff,
we need to avoid generating an always-false check some compilers will warn/error on.
